floating_gate_allowed.reason: ASAP7 gates are contacted by LIG directly on the gate and the gate layer is drawn as full-height stripes cut by GCut (10/0); a klt 0.9.0 erc spec cannot subtract the cut, so joining gate to LIG collapses VDD and VSS into one net through the uncut stripes (klayout-tools #4610). This supply run therefore models no gate-to-LIG via: every gate reports floating and is disclosed here, and gate connectivity is graded by klt lvs on the same GDS instead.
